fields.v: StateHarness (authors' own; implementation pinned to commit 72611b1; code at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StateHarness) on Claude Code 2.1.261. Baselines: unmodified Claude Code; LongHorizon-Harness (manager/executor/auditor, Ma et al. 2026)

Persistent Markdown/JSON records authored by the agent: task_state.md (initial observation, environment, current focus <=200 chars), breakthrough_log.md (event log of findings, edits, tests, decisions, rejected assumptions), file_relation_graph.md (relation notes to callers, tests, docs, config), skill_states.json (procedure guidance: use / verify / avoid / freeze), context_brief.md (working brief refreshed by fixed rules); initialization and completion protocols; diagnostic alerts

Initialize task state and focus -> work (read, edit, test) with runtime reminders to update records (every 3 edits / 3 test runs) -> before supported interface changes or deletions, change-impact retrieval returns candidate callers, tests, docs to inspect and record -> working brief refreshed from records -> behavioral signals (repeated reads, missing completions, brief neglected) may trigger a separate diagnostic session returning up to 3 alerts -> completion protocol: revisit request, relations, tests and warnings before termination (Fig. 2)
None (agent self-maintained records; completion protocol is a self-check, not human review)
Full runtime framework (records, brief, retrieval, reminders, diagnosis) run end to end; no component ablation

Model Claude Sonnet 5 for all; one run per task (no repetitions stated). Values from Table 1 (quality) and Table 2 (cost: recorded tokens, tool calls, time). No success criterion stated by the authors for any configuration, so no verdicts.
- Claude Code 2.1.261 + Sonnet 5 (baseline): RefactorBench subtasks 77.9%, chains 29.4%, refactor 94.6, cleanup 87.0 (imports 82.7, calls 93.3, docs 90.9); 25.6K tokens, 81 tool calls, 383 s. LHTB mean 0.427 (ALP 0.500, GE Audit 0.273, Foldseek 0.556, Unison 0.167, Commit0 0.639). ChainSWE bug fix 35.1%, P2P regressions 16, residual debt 60; 24.9K tokens, 75 calls, 300 s. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- StateHarness + Claude Code + Sonnet 5: RefactorBench 81.4 / 35.3 / 95.9 / 95.4 (94.4, 93.3, 100.0); 33.1K tokens, 110 calls, 529 s. LHTB mean 0.576 (0.700, 0.364, 0.556, 0.333, 0.929). ChainSWE 39.5%, P2P 23, debt 43; 35.3K tokens, 96 calls, 383 s. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors
- LongHorizon-Harness + Sonnet 5 (LHTB and ChainSWE only): LHTB mean 0.525 (0.600, 0.364, 0.556, 0.167, 0.938), per-task cost only described (more time and tool calls than StateHarness on every task); ChainSWE 32.5%, P2P 47, debt 69; 208.0K tokens, 272 calls, 2,214 s. Quality: no criterion stated by the authors; cost: no criterion stated by the authors

fields.v: Tasks: RefactorBench reorganized into 17 sequential repository-level chains with original checks; 5 LHTB SE tasks; 37 ChainSWE chains presented in one request. Configurations: Claude Code vs StateHarness (all three), plus LongHorizon-Harness (LHTB, ChainSWE). Baseline: unmodified Claude Code. Held constant: working model (Claude Sonnet 5), task input. Acceptance: benchmark tests/verifiers. Repetitions: Not stated (apparently one run). Human intervention: none; retries restore record snapshots after failed attempts

StateHarness improves primary outcome in each setting: RefactorBench chains 29.4 -> 35.3%, cleanup 87.0 -> 95.4 (imports +11.7, docs +9.1, calls 0); LHTB 0.427 -> 0.576 (better on 4 of 5 tasks, tie on Foldseek), above LH-H 0.525; ChainSWE 35.1 -> 39.5% with residual debt 60 -> 43 but P2P regressions 16 -> 23. Cost: +29% tokens, +38% time vs Claude Code on RefactorBench; about 6x fewer tokens than LH-H on ChainSWE. No significance tests

Distinguished configurations in direction, but small task counts (17 chains, 5 tasks, 37 chains) and no repetitions or statistics; authors acknowledge mixed consistency results and that token accounting is not compute-matched across harnesses; residual debt partly method-dependent (stale records counted only for record-keeping systems)

No limitations section. Stated trade-offs: runtime overhead vs Claude Code; more P2P regressions on ChainSWE; recording an unresolved problem does not force the agent to resolve it (ALP case); state transfer across separate sessions not evaluated; change-impact retrieval only Python/Cython; one LHTB task excluded for budget
